verdict.rationale: DBOS documents a workflow fork operation that restarts a workflow from a completed step, using checkpointed state to deterministically reproduce it for debugging (dbos-docs-13). The Conductor dashboard can restart any workflow from a specific step for incident response, and the same fork capability is exposed via the Conductor HTTP API and dbosctl for scripting (dbos-docs-16, dbos-docs-17, dbos-docs-32). Recorded step checkpoints can also be reviewed to audit what led to a failure (dbos-docs-29). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of fork/replay, and explicit evidence that step-level fork works in the open-source library without Conductor.
